findings.summary: M18.245 had three review rounds, and only the last is in the digest, numbered r1. The commit body of 1f1139a says 'Reviewed: r1 and r2 changes-requested (probe unreadable on green runs, progress wording), r3 pass.' The digest holds one line for the row: 'M18.245 ef9687a5... r1 pass claude:general-purpose-subagent 0 findings'. This repeats the ledger gap that 7d9c6ca disclosed for c790660 eight hours earlier, under the promise 'From now on every round is recorded before its fix (code-review step 4)'. Because review.mjs numbers a round from the tracked lines (roundOf, review.mjs:87), leaving out changes-requested rounds also resets the count that REVIEW_ROUND_CAP (3, thresholds.mjs:14) is judged against.
findings.evidence: `git show 1f1139a` body: 'Reviewed: r1 and r2 changes-requested (probe unreadable on green runs, progress wording), r3 pass.' Its digest.log hunk adds exactly one line: 'M18.245	ef9687a576a1...	r1	pass	claude:general-purpose-subagent	0 findings	content:a9cc7790...'. `grep -n M18.245 .harness/reviews/digest.log` finds only line 1227. .agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md step 4: 'Record every round, including `changes-requested`.' 7d9c6ca's progress entry: 'From now on every round is recorded before its fix (code-review step 4).' check-digest passes because it requires a pass bound to the landed content, not every round.
findings.failure_scenario: A row takes four or more rounds, records only its final pass, and the digest shows 'r1'. The cap's stop condition, which needs Huy's allowance past round 3 (M18.215), never fires, and later checkpoints cannot tell a row that passed at once from one that needed several fixes. This has now happened twice in one day after the second promise to stop it. The next reviewer cannot trust any 'r1 pass' line.

questions.coherence: Coherent. Two flake causes were fixed at their source. The clipboard listeners are on from the first commit, and the drag test is made independent of runner speed without a wait. A probe was added where the trace could not be read, and the long-held My shapes feature landed on a green main. Nothing contradicts earlier work. One loose thread: the clipboard share (useClipboardShare, use-system-clipboard.ts:147) still opens in a passive effect and learns the other tab's copy through an asynchronous ask and answer (clipboard-share.ts:74). So the text/plain-only test at clipboard.cross-document.spec.ts:142-144, which also presses Ctrl+V straight after open and bringToFront, keeps a window of the same kind. It would read 1 text element, not 3. 0dffab1's progress also says ':65 is the only test of the file that presses Ctrl+V right after open', and lines 18 and 144 do too. Nothing has flaked there yet, so I leave this as a watch item, not a finding.

No gate was weakened in the delta: check-tests-kept exits 0 on all seven commits, no threshold or retry changed, and there is no quarantine. Three mutants checked.
